metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust CLI in [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs) with an embedded doc-derived rule table in [output/src/generated_rules.rs](/workspace/output/src/generated_rules.rs) and a standard Cargo manifest at [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml). It supports `inspect`, `inspect_marcxml`, `render_iso2709`, and `render_marcxml`, normalizes `leader_template` as required, emits structured JSON errors, enforces UTF-8 MARC payload handling, and validates field/tag/indicator/subfield/repeatability rules from the mirrored LOC corpus plus MARCXML slim structure.

Verified with `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`, `cargo test --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`, end-to-end ISO2709 and MARCXML round-trips, and an `invalid_record` case for a bad indicator.
